profile.name: CryoTel GT 低温制冷机
profile.description: CryoTel GT 是一款紧凑型低温制冷机（斯特林式冷头），带集成控制器，可通过串口监控温度与功率，并在功率或温度两种模式下设置目标值，实现样品、探测器或光学组件的低温维持与稳定。设备支持温度到位判定带宽、恒温开关（thermostat）与停止模式等设置，适用于实验室中的低温测试与长期温控应用。
profile.description_en: The CryoTel GT is a compact Stirling cryocooler with an integrated controller. It communicates over a serial interface to monitor temperature and power, and supports both temperature and power control modes to maintain cryogenic setpoints for samples, detectors, and optics. It provides an adjustable at-temperature band, thermostat function, and stop modes for laboratory cryogenic experiments and long-term temperature stabilization.
